summary: Quiet night. The two loader tractors at auction both close today (12 Nov) with bids unchanged since the last run. Nothing new on Slattery or Grays that fits a want.
headlines: Case IH Maxxum 140 with loader still $43,000 after 7 bids, reserve not met, closes 6:30pm today at Grays.
Deutz-Fahr 5130 TTV with loader still $36,100 at Slattery Wagga, closes from 7:12pm today.
Passed: 2015 Kubota M9540 in Griffith, $30,000 plus GST, but 5,253 hours and no loader.
Nothing new on Slattery or Grays for the other wants.

finds.title: Linkage single-tyne ripper, North Yalgogrin
detail: no hp or shank size stated
finds.why: Closest unit to home and still $250; the bent tip needs a look, and the listing gives no hp or shank size.

finds.title: Massey Ferguson single-tyne deep ripper, 3PL (two available)
detail: two units: one lighter 1.4 m with top link, one heavy-duty large solid frame
heavy one has some rear-frame damage, still works
finds.why: The heavy-frame unit is the pick at $270, but it has frame damage and is 390 km away; price unchanged on 18 Oct.

finds.title: Massey Ferguson single-tine ripper, 3PL
finds.why: Undamaged MF single tine at $350 firm, but no hp or depth stated; unchanged after 16 weeks.

finds.title: Jarrett single-tyne ripper with pipe layer, 3PL
detail: Jarrett brand, part of an estate sale
single tyne on a tall gusseted A-frame (from photo)
no hp, shank size or depth stated
finds.why: A proper single-tyne build from a known Australian maker at under half the new price, still $600; no hp rating and about 380 km away.

finds.title: Daken 86000DC single-tine ripper, up to 100hp (new)
finds.why: 800 mm rip for $995, deepest of the new units, but rated only to 100hp and freight is extra.

finds.title: Farm-Aid FA106 heavy duty single-tine ripper (new)
finds.why: Heavy shank, 700 mm rip and a reversible point, but no shear-bolt or spring release listed and it comes by freight from Brisbane.

finds.title: About 1000 L steel diesel tank on raised stand, gravity feed
detail: heavy steel tank on elevated stand
gravity-fed, outlet, valve and hose fitted
finds.why: The tank-and-stand option for $500: gravity feeds a tractor with no pump, but it's rusty, so check inside for scale and leaks.

finds.title: Mobile fuel trailer, 1000 L, 12V pump
finds.why: 1000 L towable cart with a 12V pump, 30km away, at under half the price of the Coleambally cart; listed in June, so ring to check it's still there.

finds.title: 1000 L fuel cart with electric pump and toolbox
detail: used - good, bought but not needed
finds.why: Tidy tandem 1000 L cart with pump, 40km away; listed 9 weeks, so there may be room on price.

finds.title: Tow-behind fuel tank, 1000 L, Honda motor pump
detail: same sale has a 2,200 L overhead diesel tank
finds.why: Local 1000 L cart with a pump at a clearing sale, likely to go under the $400-$1,980 seen for similar gear.

finds.title: 850 L diesel tank
detail: in diesel use until a month ago
finds.why: Cheapest working diesel tank found, in use until last month, but rusty, bare and 190km away.

finds.title: 1000 L steel fuel tank on skids
finds.why: Clean-looking 1000 L tank 40km away, but bare: budget for a pump or a stand.

finds.title: 26-plate trailing offset discs, no ram
finds.why: A third of the price of the next-cheapest disc; budget a lift ram and check width is under 3.5 m.

finds.title: Baldan CRSG28 28-plate trailing offset disc
detail: seller says it needs about 130hp; pulled with a Case 1370
plates worn: seller quoted $135+GST a plate to replace (about $3,800+GST for 28)
width not stated by seller; a WA dealer's new CRSG28 lists 3,200 mm and 125-140hp
Serafin (Yoogali) lists a new CRSG 28+1 at $24,400+GST
buyer must load and cart it
finds.why: A proper heavy Brazilian 28-plate at a third of new, but it sits at the top of the hp range and needs about $3,800 in plates to bite like new.

finds.title: Blue Line 28-plate offset disc, new bearings and ram seals, width not stated
detail: disc gang bearings replaced as required
width and model not stated; no Blue Line maker spec found online to cite
finds.why: Closest used 28-plate, with the bearing work done. Measure the width and check plate wear in person.

finds.title: Heavy duty Australian made 24-plate offset discs
detail: front gang of 12 discs just replaced with new bearings, receipt over $5,000
seller says it needs at least 90hp
finds.why: Meets every must and the front gang was just redone, but it is at the edge of the 400 km range and the rear plates are at about 60%.

finds.title: New 1BZ-2.5 24-plate trailing offset disc, crated
detail: listing's own spec table gives 2,500 mm working width (2,810 mm overall); the text above it says 1,900 mm
new, comes unassembled in an iron crate
finds.why: Brand new for the price of a used set, but it is a light Chinese build rated to 100hp and needs assembling.

finds.title: Jarrett 28-plate offset discs, hardly used
finds.price_note: ONO; page shows US$9,000 but the seller's text says $9000 ono
detail: 28 plates, Jarrett; model not named and no Jarrett spec found online to cite
seller says excellent condition, hardly used
bearing and plate wear not stated
finds.why: A hardly-used 28-plate for $9,000 about 200 km away, but the listing is three lines long: get the width and hp before driving.

finds.title: Expanding container cabin, 2 bed, full bathroom, base unit (new)
detail: full bathroom, plumbed ready to connect
dealer: GV Containers and Haulage, free delivery within 30km of Cobram, delivery further out at extra cost
finds.why: New 2-bed with a full bathroom, in stock 180km away. GST could take it close to $22k and it still needs wiring, but it is the cheapest new 2-bed nearby.

finds.title: New expanding container cabin, 2 bed, bathroom, kitchen
detail: L-shaped kitchen cabinets, stainless sink, mixer tap
electrical and plumbing ready for connection
finds.why: Premium model from the same Cobram dealer with the kitchen fitted; it clears every must and every prefer at 180km.

finds.title: EXEQ L0206 expandable container house with ensuite (unused)
finds.why: Same box as the $25,850 2-bed model for $7.7k less, but no bedroom wall or kitchen is shown, so confirm the layout.

finds.title: New 20ft expandable granny flat, 2 bed, bathroom, kitchenette
finds.price_note: Pickup only. Same dealer has a near-identical ad saying $27,000 + GST, so confirm $18k
finds.why: Cheapest new 2-bed with bathroom in range, but the dealer's other ads are priced higher, so check the price first.

finds.title: 2010 homemade container home, bunk room, kitchenette, lounge, toilet and shower
finds.why: Clears the bathroom and two-room bar for $19k inside 250km, but it is homemade and the listing is thin, so inspect it.

finds.title: Portable accommodation building, 6m x 3m, with bathroom
finds.why: Solid 6m hut with a bathroom and delivery on offer, but the ad does not say it has two rooms.

finds.title: 2014 Deutz-Fahr 5130 TTV with ALO X56P loader
finds.price_note: current bid, 2 bids; plus 12.5% buyer premium incl GST ($30-50k band); $1,000 deposit
detail: ALO X56P loader, Euro hitch, 3rd service
hp not stated on lot page
torn operator seat; no log book
finds.why: Low hours, loader fitted, 140km away and bidding well under budget; inspect at Wagga today before 5pm.

finds.title: 2016 Case IH Maxxum 140 with Challenge Prime-Lift 50S loader
finds.price_note: current bid, 7 bids, reserve not met; plus variable buyer premium and admin fee; GST inclusive
finds.why: Every must cleared with attachments thrown in, and bidding is $37k under budget with hours to go.

finds.title: 2015 Kioti PX1002 100hp 4WD cab with KL901 loader, slasher, post-hole digger
finds.price_note: marked sold on AuctionsPlus; price not shown
detail: cab with air con and heat
finds.why: Full package with low hours; tractor and loader net out around $44-48k after the attachments.

finds.title: 2022 McCormick S-Max 90hp 4WD cab tractor with loader and 4-in-1 bucket, 251 hours
finds.price_note: private sale; GST not mentioned; seller will consider a swap for an Iveco tray truck
detail: 90hp turbo diesel, 4WD (the seller lists it as 'McCormick SMAX 90 HP 4WD 2022')
4-in-1 bucket; the photo shows a McCormick-branded loader, but the loader model is not stated
still listed 18 Oct at the same price after 10 weeks; service history and AdBlue not stated
a 2024 ex-demo S-Max 90 cab is advertised in NSW at $55,000 drive away with the loader extra (search result only; the listing could not be opened)
finds.why: Still the best value on the list: a 2022 cab tractor with a 4-in-1 loader at 251 hrs, 190 km away. It is $18,000 under the ceiling and has sat 10 weeks, so there is room to offer.

finds.title: 2017 John Deere 6110M 4WD cab with 623R loader
finds.price_note: no bid shown before the sale; 2% buyer premium; auction 12 Nov 4:00pm AEDT
detail: 623R loader per listing title - confirm on inspection
finds.why: 2017 Deere under 2,000 hours with a Deere loader; in band if it sells under $80k.

finds.title: 2002 New Holland TL100A cab with Challenge AP30 loader
detail: new turbo and injectors, fresh oils and filters
finds.why: Cab, loader and 98hp in band at $48,500, but 24 years old and hours not stated; ask for hours first.

finds.title: 2010 McCormick T-Max 100 92hp 4WD with loader and 4-in-1 bucket, 1,375 hours
detail: 92hp Perkins engine, 1,375 hours, 4WD with rear diff lock
front-end loader with 4-in-1 bucket; loader make not stated
photo shows an enclosed cab, which the text does not mention
still listed 18 Oct at the same price, 10 weeks on; service history and AdBlue not stated; 410 km is just past the 400 km radius
finds.why: Clears every must at 92hp and 1,375 hrs with a cab and a 4-in-1 loader, and it is $7,400 under the ceiling. It is 410 km away and has sat for 10 weeks, so there is room to offer.

finds.title: Massey Ferguson 7614 with front-end loader and bucket
finds.price_note: no bid shown before the sale; clearing sale 12 Nov 8:30am AEDT
finds.why: One owner, serviced and low hours, so it clears every must on paper, but it sits at the 140hp top of the band and may sell above $80k.
